spacing_row_cm.quote: For green manure crop sow 20 kg seed per acre either with drill in rows 22.5 cm apart or by broadcast.
spacing_row_cm.note: The page says 22.5 cm; stored as whole centimetres (23).

water_need.note: 2-3 irrigations: read as 'low'. Agronomist to confirm.
